stories.title: Allahabad HC slams UP govt for misusing Goondas Act, warns of damages
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court criticised the UP government for misusing the Goondas Act. The court noted the law was used for harassment and warned of damages. It also questioned the use of the NSA against a student activist. Procedural shortcuts and executive overreach are becoming systemic issues. Law enforcement must adhere to constitutional rights and due process.

stories.title: Kevin Warsh-led Federal Reserve starts US war on inflation
stories.summary: The US Federal Reserve increased interest rates, signaling a global effort to control rising inflation. Other central banks will likely follow the Fed's lead in this concerted action. Higher global rates and trade friction will impact India's economy and markets. The Indian rupee faces pressure from a strengthening US dollar. Domestic consumption offers some buffer, but inflation concerns persist.
